plugin.idc-resource.peerLifecycle.descri: Before disabling the connector, check how much unfinished business remains. An authorized administrator can manually reconfirm authorization if the check fails. After a restart or another connector is enabled or disabled, reconfirm if this check fails again. Check every connector again before disabling it. This action only handles the peer connector.
plugin.idc-resource.peerLifecycle.confir: This reruns the current peer connector enablement and authorization workflow and may refresh a build with the same version. It does not explicitly disable the connector or reopen stopped new business. If its version or state changes, handle it in plugin management first. This is not a permanent repair; reconfirm manually when needed.
